ctx.x: Do you remember any other live performances that you went to of any of the other people whose sound you liked?

Oh. Oh. Oh, I liked Roy (Eldridge). He came to Round Lake in Lansing and I rode my bicycle out there; it was three miles out, but I'll never forget this. This was in 1937, I think, and so...I couldn't get in, so I was lookin' through the...they had these bars up to the windows...he saw me lookin' in, so he says "Come on kid," and I come in and that was a great night. Roy was blowin' and he had Franz Jackson in the band and...let's see who else did he have? I think it was Zutty (Singleton) and I thought that was…

Roy sounded so wonderful, I never forgot that. I told him about it many years later. Yeah, that was a tremendous experience. Haha. I was into it by then. Ha ha. Yeah. But he was so nice to me, yes he was.
